name: R1b (2026-11-22: level 2 of the stochastic backreaction, on a branch)
what: core, in a spare worktree on Opus: <scalar_field> noise_level = 2 with tests and a branch executable, for the reproduction of arXiv:2512.14649
note: Releases core-v0.4 to v0.6 are on main. Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0025 to 0029. The weekly usage window of the account is at 86 per cent: read what the task needs.

items.task: The stochastic backreaction of level 2 for the scalar field's noise: <scalar_field> noise_level = 2 (coord/DECISIONS/0028 and 0029 item 2; the request with the equations, the smallest design that serves, and the tests is drafted by Track E at /data/haiyangw/nrpic/wt/E-stoch-inf/tracks/E-stoch-inf/repro/scope/outbox_draft/core_noise_level2.md: read it first, then the paper's own text: /data/haiyangw/nrpic/kb-data/raw/arxiv/2512.14649/v2/src/PRD_v2.tex lines 220-323 (the equation of R in its well-posed form), 474-500 (pipeline), 697-713 (schemes), 776-791 (levels of backreaction); the existing implementation athenak/src/scalar_field/scalar_field_noise.cpp (levels 0 and 1; lines 162-166 refuse level 2) and coord/INTERFACES/scalar_field.md, scalar_field_2.md, scalar_field_3.md; Track E's map of the paper's terms to the source: wt/E-stoch-inf/tracks/E-stoch-inf/repro/equations/EQUATIONS.md section (e)). This is production source written on Opus because the weekly usage window does not hold a session on Fable; it stays on its branch until a review on Fable: write it so that the review is easy (small, commented where the physics is, no change of behaviour with the option absent). Work: (1) design note first (tracks/core/interfaces/noise_level2.md): the two mesh fields (R and its momentum in the paper's well-posed form), their initialisation at t* from the existing synthesis, their evolution with the driver's stages and the field's stencils with the local lapse, K, and field momentum as coefficients, the projection onto the mode set at each stage (the adjoint of the synthesis, same normalisation), the noise built from the projected coefficients exactly as now; what the paper leaves unstated (which background the window uses) and your choice, stated; memory and cost at 256 cells. (2) Implementation in athenak/src/scalar_field/ (Kokkos, card and processor builds; restart; the non-finite guard), default unchanged. (3) Tests, predictions first in tracks/core/JOURNAL-noise-level2.md: a homogeneous slice (level 2 equals level 1 to rounding); 32 cells with a small mode set: the reconstructed R against the linear reference within the track's threshold (0.02 per mode) and the split under the sign of the amplitude (level 2 adds an even part only); the mesh R against the per-shell mode functions in the linear regime (they must differ by the stencil symbol of the Laplacian, 2.7 per cent in k^2 at the cut: measure it); byte regression against release core-v0.6 with the option absent (tracks/core/analysis/release/ drivers); one card smoke run at 64 cells of each scenario of the paper (problems/scalar/sr_stochastic.athinput, usr_stochastic.athinput) with timing against level 0. At most one card-hour. (4) Tell Track E (outbox message) the executable and the two inputs of the ablation at 256 cells, levels 0, 1, 2. Keep the session to about two and a half hours: if the design does not converge in that time, stop with the branch pushed and say exactly what is missing.
